statements.statement: The procedure code billed was CPT 93247
The denial reason code was CO-197
The clinical indication note documents recurrent palpitations and intermittent lightheadedness in the setting of known unspecified atrial fibrillation and cardiac arrhythmia
The patient has a documented personal history of transient ischemic attack and cerebral infarction
Long-term continuous ECG monitoring is indicated to assess for paroxysmal arrhythmic events and optimize anticoagulation management
